title: fix(pm): post-stamped tolerates the footer blank-line collapse, and its refusal text stops asserting the platform never takes a byte
body:
Fixes #19048

Clause-②: no

`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --body=N` compared the bytes it sent against the bytes it read
back and exited **4 — WRITTEN BUT NOT STORED** on a difference that is one newline: the blank
line immediately before the platform's own attribution footer, collapsed when the platform
re-anchors a block the body already carried. Its refusal text asserted the opposite model of
the platform, in the sentence the card measured false.

## The reading this lands on

| Card | sent / stored | recorded first difference |
|---|---|---|
| objectstack#19104 | 6395 / 6394 | byte 6338 |
| objectui#9771 | 54579 / 54578 | byte 54522 |
| objectstack#19120 | 4720 / 4719 | — |
| objectstack#18572 | 5282 / 5281 | — |
| objectstack#19143 | −1 byte | — |
| objectstack#19151 | −1 byte | — |

Every one of them substance byte-identical after stripping the footer, and every one exited 4.
The difference, verbatim from the tool, with the newlines spelled out:

```
sent   …backslash-n ---backslash-n _Generated by …_
stored …---backslash-n _Generated by …_
```

⇒ one of the two newlines in front of the footer's rule, and nothing else. The footer block is
58 bytes, so the collapse puts the first difference at `sent_bytes - 58 + 1`. **That arithmetic
is the confirmation, not an assumption:** 6395 − 58 + 1 = 6338 and 54579 − 58 + 1 = 54522, the
two offsets that were actually recorded. Both fall **out** of the fixtures below; neither was
computed into them.

## Acceptance notes

**The criterion** — the first deliverable, now stated in a docblock beside the comparator. The
platform's footer path is **positional** and touches exactly one span: the newline(s) between
the last content byte and the block's rule, plus the block itself when the platform synthesises
one. Inside that span it does three measured things — it appends the block, it moves a trailing
newline the act sent to the front of it, or it collapses the blank line before the rule — and it
has never been measured adding, removing or substituting a byte anywhere else. The sanitizer's
mutations are the other population and they are what exit 4 exists for: a tag-shaped fragment
eaten out of the prose, a link rewritten inside the block, a size refusal the platform never
reported that leaves the previous body stored, a truncation; those land anywhere in the body.
So the test stays positional and exact — each arm builds its candidate from the sent bytes and
compares with `===`, every head byte compared literally — and the normalised "non-empty lines"
reading (shape **B** on the card) is deliberately **not** what landed: it would answer clean for
a whitespace-only truncation anywhere in the body, a loss with no line of its own. A pinned case
holds that door shut.

**What changed, in three pieces.**

1. `footerReAnchoring` gains a **third** exact arm, `collapsed`, requiring the act to have sent
   the block with **no** trailing newline of its own — a body that sent trailing newlines *and*
   came back collapsed is a cell nobody has measured, and the arm refuses it.
2. It gets its **own** class, `footer-blank-collapsed`, routed through a new `FOOTER_SHAPE_CLASSES`
   map. ⛔ Not the re-anchor's word: that class's declared text says "nothing added, nothing lost"
   and this shape loses one byte, so one word for both would say something untrue about the bytes.
   The read-back line names what was tolerated and why — the blank line before the rule was
   collapsed, so the one byte short is that separator newline and every **content** byte is stored.
3. The refusal text no longer carries the falsified sentence; it describes the three measured
   shapes instead, including that the collapse really does take one newline and that a content
   byte has never been measured going with it.

**Self-test: 477 → 510 cases, 16 → 17 batteries, exit 0.** The new battery reproduces the recorded
byte counts of the four pairs that have them, the delta of the two recorded only as "−1 byte", and
both recorded offsets. Negative controls keep exit 4 for: one byte changed elsewhere, one byte lost
before the rule, a tag-shaped fragment eaten, a shorter body (truncation ending in the block), a
loss inside the block, both newlines gone, and a whitespace-only truncation in the content.

**Ablation — the new cases can fail.** With the `collapsed` arm's return deleted on disk (via
`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 → 0, blob `271c57581316` → `065810a65e70`), the
self-test goes **12 of 510 failed, exit 1**, and the #19104 fixture prints the card's own line
verbatim: `⚠️ read-back: sent 6395 byte(s), stored 6394 — the platform MUTATED the body`. Restored
to `271c57581316` == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. Both runs are on the committed state.

**Line reading: 3,618 → 3,753, net +135** — over the +60 the dispatch carried. Reported, not
absorbed: see the report on the card for the per-deliverable breakdown and the two trims available.

**Not in this PR:** #18995 (opening-line `{{WAS}}` vs H56), #19238 (the quoted-span audit) and
#19152 (the write-time keyed-line reader) queue behind this card on the same file and are not
addressed here. `stampVerdict`, the token substitution and the audit are untouched.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 受管正文写入工具 `post-stamped.mjs` 的读回比对器。它会把「发出去的字节」和
「平台存下来的字节」逐字节对比,一旦不同就退出 4 并告诉调用方「这次写入没落地」。现在它多认一种
平台行为:平台重锚自己的署名页脚时,会把页脚横线前面那个空行吃掉一个换行。这一种照旧放行并说明
放行了什么,其它任何字节差异照旧退出 4。

**为什么改** —— 这个判定是**错的**,而且是每次都错。今天本车道 12 次正文写入、分诊席 5 次、
另一仓 1 次,全部因为这一个换行退出 4,而正文其实完整落地了。工具自己的拒绝文案里写着排除条件
(「页脚重锚什么都不会拿走」),这次读数把那句话证伪了。代价不是误报本身:这个检查是用来抓
sanitizer 真把内容吃掉的,一个五次里响五次的警报会被席位学会跳过 —— 那时真的丢字节就没人看了。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险是把一次**真的**丢字节读成页脚重锚。因此判据钉在**位置**上而不是
长度或「忽略空行」上:只容忍紧贴页脚横线前面那一个换行,正文部分逐字节 `===` 比对,发送侧带尾部
换行的组合(没人测过)明确拒绝。卡面的方案 B(按非空行比对)被明确拒掉,因为它会放过正文里任何
纯空白的截断,并有一条用例钉死这一点。⛔ 不是「放宽检查」。回滚成本为零:一个文件、一次提交,
`git revert` 即可,没有生成物、没有发布面、没有数据迁移。本次净增 135 行,超出派发给的 +60 预算,
已在报告中如实申报并给出两个可选的压缩路径,⛔ 未自行抬预算。

**席位意见** ——

**你要做的** —— 两件。① 这个 PR 没有 changeset,而 `Check Changeset` 只认 `skip-changeset`
标签作豁免(它按新增 `.changeset/*.md` 计数,没有路径过滤);本 dev 被派发词禁止写标签,所以这个
标签要由席位补上,否则该检查会一直红。② 净增行数超预算这件事请席位裁一下:是接受 135 行,还是要
本 dev 按报告里的两个路径压缩后重推。
